title: Voice Vote
tagline: Voice Vote: Anonymous, AI-powered civic platform on 0g mainnet for secure, transparent engagement.
description:
Citizens often hesitate to raise their voice due to fear of exposure, lack of anonymity, or mistrust in governance systems. Voice Vote eliminates these barriers by enabling people to express opinions, cast anonymous votes, and report civic issues with complete privacy.

Every post or vote is backed by Anon Aadhaar verification, ensuring that only real individuals participate without revealing personal identities. Posts and votes are analyzed by AI (Alith AI) for urgency and importance, while the community moderates through voting, flagging, and discussion.

The platform is powered by the 0g mainnet, ensuring scalability, decentralization, and tamper-proof civic records. With rewards and recognition for active contributors, Voice Vote transforms civic participation into a transparent and community-driven process.

Key Features :

📸 Anonymous Reporting & Voting – Share issues, opinions, or cast votes without identity exposure.
🔐 Anon Aadhaar Verification – Prove you’re real, stay anonymous.
🧠 AI Prioritization – AI ranks posts/votes based on urgency.
🗳️ Community Moderation – Vote, comment, and validate authenticity.
🌐 Geo-Filtering – Posts tailored by location.
🧱 Built on 0g Mainnet – Decentralized, scalable, and censorship-resistant.
🎖️ Rewards & Badges – Earn recognition for meaningful civic participation.
how_its_made:
Voice Vote combines identity privacy, AI intelligence, and decentralized infrastructure to create a secure civic voice platform.

Anon Aadhaar – Provides one-time anonymous identity verification to ensure real users without revealing personal data.

0g Mainnet – Handles decentralized storage of verifiable civic metadata and proofs, ensuring immutability and censorship-resistance.

Alith AI – Natural Language Processing (NLP) engine that prioritizes and categorizes posts based on urgency and seriousness.

NSFWJS – Filters and blocks inappropriate or irrelevant media uploads.

Geo-Location APIs – Enable region-based filtering so users only see relevant local issues.

Community Governance – Voting, flagging, and commenting mechanisms to ensure content authenticity and reduce spam.

Badge & Reward System – Incentivizes positive contributions and transparent civic participation.

Together, these technologies empower citizens to voice their concerns safely, ensure government visibility, and create a transparent digital democracy on the 0g mainnet.
